name: Powerful Sorcery
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

Whenever you cast a spell gained from your bloodline list of bonus spells, as a swift action you may also cast spell of 0-level, 1st-level or 2nd-level with a range of “personal” and a target of “you.”
